newsVersionExact: Anthropic announced September 16 that it is merging Claude chat and Cowork into one Claude experience.
actualMeaningExact: A person can ask a quick question or hand over a longer, multi-step task without choosing a mode first.
mechanismExact: Anthropic says Manual asks before actions; Auto reduces check-ins.
familiarExampleExact: Once the new experience reaches your account, attach three appliance manuals and ask Claude to make an editable seasonal-maintenance checklist.

learningConnections.concept: Set an authority line before delegating
learningConnections.learningPayoff: Name what the agent may do, when it must ask and when it must stop.
